desc: Derive and verify the identity expressing \(f(x)\) through divisibility indicators \(2^k\mid x\).
Design the residue-class pair aggregation for each modulus, including self-complementary classes and avoiding double counting.
Compute the total pair-value sum for \(i\le j\), including diagonal pairs.
Implement efficient integer accumulation across powers of two.
Implement and sample-test the Python solution; all three public samples passed.
